title: Ek raat mein lakh ka AI bill?
description: An API key pushed to a public repo, with the .env file.
steps: Revoke the key right away and make a new one. Deleting the repo doesn’t help.
Put .env in .gitignore. Keys live in the environment, never in the code.
Set a spending limit with your AI provider.

title: Mere laptop pe toh chalta hai!
description: Three machines, three Node versions, three different results.
steps: Write your versions down in a file: Node, Python, everything.
Commit the lockfile, so every machine installs the same packages.
Use a dev container: one setup, the same on every machine. Run your AI agent inside it too.

title: Weekend mein AI se app bana liya?
description: Three checks before you launch an app an AI built.
steps: Login and permissions: one user must never see another user’s data.
Automatic daily backups, and restore one once to prove it works.
Error alerts, so you hear about a crash before your customers do.

title: AI pagal ho gaya?
description: A 300-message chat fills the context window.
steps: Start a fresh session for every big task.
Paste a short summary of the old chat into the new one.
Keep your project rules in one AGENTS.md file that every session reads.

title: Yeh AI bill kisne kiya?!
description: The biggest model for a spelling check. Every day.
steps: Small job, small model.
Turn on prompt caching.
Set a spending limit on every key or project.

title: Cursor ya Claude Code? Dono.
description: Choose the tool by the job, not by the hype.
steps: Small edits you want to watch: an agent inside the editor, like Cursor.
Long jobs across files, tests and commands: a terminal agent, like Claude Code.
Give both the same rules: one AGENTS.md that both tools read.

title: AI ka package = hacker ka?
description: Slopsquatting: attackers publish the package names AI makes up.
steps: Check the registry before you install: when it was published, by whom and how many downloads.
Commit the lockfile, and don’t let your agent add a dependency without asking.
Add a dependency check to CI.

title: Bunty ne prod uda diya
description: Sandbox, permissions and checkpoints before an agent touches production.
steps: Run the agent in a sandbox, never against production.
Give it only the permissions the task needs.
Make a git checkpoint before every agent run.

title: Vibe coding: three non-negotiables
description: Project memory, small changes and verified work.
steps: Give the agent project memory: an AGENTS.md file.
Ask for small changes, one task at a time.
Verify the work: run it and read the diff.
